title: J-tau: A Fully Localized Japanese Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2610.19638v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present J-tau, the first publicly available Japanese benchmark for evaluating tool-using LLM agents in interactive customer-support scenarios. While tau-bench is widely used to evaluate LLM agents, it is English-centric and cannot evaluate agents in other languages. Existing multilingual extensions offer no public Japanese version and rely primarily on machine translation, leaving locale-specific entities such as addresses and currencies inconsistent with the target region. To enable reliable evaluation in Japanese, we carefully localize tau-bench through machine translation, entity adaptation, and human review. During this process, we also uncover and fix two flaws in the original tau-bench: invalid tasks and a score aggregation error that inflates certain models' results. Experiments show that J-tau yields fewer evaluation errors than a naively machine-translated counterpart and that our fixes resolve both flaws.

translated_title: J-tau：一个完全本地化的日语工具-智能体-用户交互基准
translated_abstract: 我们提出了J-tau，这是首个公开可用的日语基准，用于在交互式客户支持场景中评估使用工具的LLM智能体。虽然tau-bench被广泛用于评估LLM智能体，但它以英语为中心，无法评估其他语言的智能体。现有的多语言扩展没有提供公开的日语版本，且主要依赖机器翻译，导致地址和货币等特定地区实体与目标区域不一致。为了实现日语环境下的可靠评估，我们通过机器翻译、实体适配和人工审核，对tau-bench进行了细致的本地化。在此过程中，我们还发现并修复了原始tau-bench中的两个缺陷：无效任务和一个会夸大某些模型结果的分数聚合错误。实验表明，J-tau比简单机器翻译的对应版本产生更少的评估错误，并且我们的修复解决了这两个缺陷。
tldr: J-tau是首个公开可用的完全本地化日语基准，通过机器翻译、实体适配和人工审核对tau-bench进行本地化以评估使用工具的LLM智能体，并在此过程中发现并修复了原始tau-bench中的无效任务和分数聚合错误两个缺陷。
en_tdlr: J-tau is the first publicly available fully localized Japanese benchmark for evaluating tool-using LLM agents, built through machine translation, entity adaptation, and human review of tau-bench, while also uncovering and fixing two flaws in the original benchmark: invalid tasks and a score aggregation error.
